answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on invitation quota tree, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. Each submission hangs on the ferrous of a task receipt, and the crystal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the oasis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
